title: Taking, Asking, Helping — and Liking
label: ch:hi-pasand
canDo: I can say I take, ask and help in Hindi, build a conjunct verb out of any noun plus करना, and say what I like the way Hindi says it — with the thing liked as the subject and me in the dative.

payoff.summary: Say लेना, पूछना and मदद करना, then turn the sentence inside out: मुझे रोटी पसंद है is bread being pleasing to me, so है agrees with the bread and I move into मुझे — the same inversion Spanish and Italian reached on their own.
